Home.title: Tools for electrical and electronics engineering
Home.subtitle: Stack of Circuits is a web application for amateurs and professionals in the field of electronics. Here you will find various calculators and tools that will help you in the calculations and design of electronic circuits and devices.

BatteryLife.title: Battery Life Calculator
BatteryLife.description: Calculation of the battery life of the device from the battery or accumulator

article.title: Calculation of the battery life of the device from the battery
article.paragraph: This calculator provides two options — basic and advanced — to determine the expected battery life of the device. To calculate, you must specify the battery capacity, as well as the current consumed by the device.

InductorColorCode.title: Inductor Color Code Calculator
InductorColorCode.description: Calculation of the nominal value and tolerance of inductors by color code

article.title: Calculation of the nominal inductance by color code
article.paragraph: The inductors are marked with colored stripes that indicate the nominal value and tolerance. This calculator allows you to calculate the nominal value and tolerance of inductors. Calculation is supported for inductors with color markings in the form of 4 colored stripes.

LedResistor.title: LED Resistor Calculator
LedResistor.description: Calculating the resistance of a current limiting resistor for LEDs, ideal when you have one or more series LEDs and you need to calculate which resistor is needed

article.title: Calculation of the current limiting resistor for LEDs
article.paragraph: Each LED has a maximum allowable current with which it can operate normally. Even a short-term excess of this maximum current will damage the LED. Thus, it is necessary to limit the current flowing through the LED, one of the ways is to connect a current-limiting resistor in series. It is important to note that this method is not recommended for high-power LEDs that need a full-fledged current regulator.
article.paragraph2: This calculator allows you to calculate the value of the current limiting resistor, which must be connected in series to the LEDs to limit the current. To do this, enter the specified values. The calculator will also calculate the power dissipated by the resistor, which will help you select the necessary power resistor.

OhmsLaw.title: Ohm's Law Calculator
OhmsLaw.description: Calculation of electrical circuit parameters using Ohm's law

article.title: Calculation of electrical circuit parameters using Ohm's law
article.paragraph: This calculator allows you to calculate voltage, resistance or current if you set any two other parameters. To use this tool, select the parameter to be calculated and enter the values of the other two parameters of the electrical circuit.

ParallelEquivalence.title: Parallel Equivalence Calculator
ParallelEquivalence.description: Calculation of the equivalence value of parallel resistors, capacitors and inductors

article.title: Calculating the equivalence of a parallel connection
article.paragraph: This calculator allows you to calculate the equivalent of parallel connected resistors, capacitors and inductors. To calculate, select the required element and enter the values.This calculator allows you to calculate the equivalent of parallel connected resistors, capacitors and inductors. To calculate, select the required element and enter the values.

ResistorColorCode.title: Resistor Color Code Calculator
ResistorColorCode.description: Calculation of the nominal value and tolerance of resistors by color code

article.title: Calculation of the nominal value of the resistor by color code
article.paragraph: The resistors are marked with colored stripes that indicate the nominal value and tolerance of the resistor. This calculator allows you to calculate the nominal value, tolerance, and temperature coefficient for some resistors. Calculation is supported for color-coded resistors in the form of 4, 5 or 6 color bands.

SmdResistorCode.title: SMD Resistor Code Calculator
SmdResistorCode.description: Calculation of the resistance of an SMD resistor by code

article.title: Calculation of the nominal value of SMD resistors by code
article.paragraph: SMD resistors are marked with numbers and letters that indicate the nominal value of the resistor. This calculator allows you to calculate the nominal value for resistors marked with 3 or 4 characters. The EIA-96 marking is also supported.

article.title: Calculation of the voltage divider
article.paragraph: A voltage divider is an easy way to get a lower voltage, for this you need to connect two resistors in series and take the voltage between them. To calculate the voltage divider, it is necessary to enter the nominal value of the resistors and the input voltage.

form.errorMsg: The supply voltage must be higher than the voltage drop on the LEDs
